name: AbuseIPDB - Service Principal or Managed Identity Auth from Blacklisted IP
description: Detects successful Service Principal or Managed Identity authentication from an IP with AbuseIPDB confidence score >= 80. Non-human identity auth from known malicious infrastructure indicates compromised app credentials, leaked secrets, or API key theft.
query:
let HighConfidenceIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 80
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
union
(AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, ResourceDisplayName, SignInType = 'ServicePrincipal'),
(AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | where ResultType == 0 | project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, ResourceDisplayName, SignInType = 'ManagedIdentity')
| where IPAddress in ((HighConfidenceIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner HighConfidenceIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| project TimeGenerated, ServicePrincipalName, IPAddress, AbuseScore, Country, ResourceDisplayName, SignInType
